word: I’m honored to be with you today for your commencement from one of the finest universities in the world.
meaning: 我很榮幸今天能和你們一起，參加你們在世界頂尖大學之一的畢業典禮。
example: He says he feels proud to attend the graduation at a great university.
hint:
中文解釋：表達受邀出席畢業典禮的榮幸。
1) commencement (n.): 畢業典禮；syn: graduation; ant: enrollment
2) finest (adj.): 最好的；syn: best; ant: worst
pronunciation: Focus: I'm HON-ored | com-MENCE-ment | ONE of the FIN-est. Pause after 'today'.

word: Truth be told, I never graduated from college.
meaning: 說實話，我從來沒有大學畢業。
example: He admits honestly that he did not finish college.
hint:
中文解釋：用很坦白的方式承認自己沒拿到大學學位。
1) truth be told (phr.): 說真的；syn: honestly; ant: falsely
2) graduate (v.): 畢業；syn: finish; ant: drop out
pronunciation: Chunk: TRUTH be told | I NE-ver GRAD-u-a-ted from COL-lege.

word: And this is the closest I’ve ever gotten to a college graduation.
meaning: 而這就是我人生中離大學畢業最近的一次。
example: He jokes that speaking at this event is his nearest experience of a college graduation.
hint:
中文解釋：帶點幽默，說自己沒畢業但今天算是最接近畢業典禮。
1) the closest (adj.): 最接近的；syn: nearest; ant: farthest
2) graduation (n.): 畢業；syn: commencement; ant: dropout
pronunciation: Emphasis: the CLO-sest | E-ver GOT-ten | COL-lege grad-u-A-tion.

word: Today I want to tell you three stories from my life.
meaning: 今天我想跟你們分享我人生中的三個故事。
example: He plans to share three life stories with the audience.
hint:
中文解釋：清楚宣布演講結構：三個故事。
1) story (n.): 故事；syn: tale; ant: fact
2) from my life (phr.): 取自我的人生經歷；syn: from my experience; ant: imaginary
pronunciation: Rhythm: To-DAY | I want to TELL you | THREE STO-ries | from my LIFE.

example: He says the plan is simple and limited.
hint:
中文解釋：強調內容很簡單、不複雜。
1) that's it (phr.): 就這樣；syn: that's all; ant: that's not all

example: He downplays it and says it is not a big matter.
hint:
中文解釋：語氣輕鬆，淡化事情的重大性。
1) big deal (n.): 大事；syn: important matter; ant: trivial thing

example: He repeats the simple structure: only three stories.
hint:
中文解釋：再次重申「只有三個」來建立期待。
1) just (adv.): 只是；syn: only; ant: more than
2) story (n.): 故事；syn: account; ant: silence

word: The first story is about connecting the dots.
meaning: 第一個故事是關於把點連成線（串起人生的線索）。
example: The first story explains how different events in life connect later.
hint:
中文解釋：主題句：人生很多事當下看不懂，回頭才會發現彼此相連。
1) connect (v.): 連結；syn: link; ant: separate
2) dots (n.): 點、線索；syn: clues; ant: answers
pronunciation: Phrase: con-NECT-ing the DOTS. Slight pause after 'story'.
